title: Pipeline run receipt (spec 080 FR-007)
description: `_pipeline/runs/<run_id>/run.json` — what one weekly-pipeline run did, how long it took, what it cost and where every artifact it produced is. Derived on every phase close as a pure function of `pipeline-state.json` plus what is on disk (FR-006). Evolution follows ADR-0013: additive within `1.x`, a new schema file per major, `schema_version` carried in the payload so a consumer can refuse a shape it does not know.

schema_version.description: Refuse a 2.x payload; accept any 1.x, which is additive by ADR-0013.

run_id.description: The join key to `pipeline-state.json`. Minute-granular with a `-2`, `-3`, … suffix on collision (FR-002).

finished_at.description: Null while the run is open — i.e. while any phase is not yet terminal.

framework_version.description: The package version string. Distinct from the state file's integer `framework_version`, which is a schema version.

reconstructed.description: True when the run directory was created after the run began — a state file written before spec 080 shipped (FR-004). Anything the earlier phases wrote is not under it.

verbs.description: The verbs that wrote into this run, in order.

total_usd.description: The sum over sidecars that could be read. A LOWER BOUND whenever `sidecars_missing` is above zero, and every rendering must say so (FR-013).

sidecars_missing.description: Sidecars a dispatch asked for and that could not be read. Never folded into the total as zero (spec 078 FR-015).

duration_s.description: Null when either timestamp is missing — a phase killed before writing `finished_at` has no duration, and that must read as unknown, not as zero.

cost_usd.description: Null when no sidecar was requested, or when the one requested could not be read.
